independent_review.rationale: Destination geometry that is independent of prefix reference contents is recovered before requiring an alias inventory. The shortcut authenticates builtin coordinate meaning, exact declaring types and the performed receiving type, strips only one exclusive formal shell, and rejects traversal through interior references. Loaded/stored aliases retain the original captured-prefix and exposure requirements. This resolves the demonstrated full-std source regression without discarding recast parent debt or original entry-sibling preservation. The exact-candidate optimized corpus retry also passes all 21 selected source fixtures with their intended outcomes. The earlier link/infrastructure failure remains a distinct nonaccepted attempt.

semantic_assessment.formal_and_descriptor_identity: Shared formal bindings are excluded by access.is_exclusive(); their descriptors may be rebound. Exclusive outer addresses are fixed within the invocation, while nested reference slots remain prefix-dependent. Receiving-type equality distinguishes descriptor replacement from referent stores.
semantic_assessment.missing_evidence: A missing reference inventory remains None, never Some(empty). The ordered-value consumer refuses reference-based noninterference when this inventory is unavailable. Genuinely unknown loaded addresses continue to fail closed; no speculative unknown-store fallback was added.
semantic_assessment.rhs_and_selectors: Recovered coordinates do not prove RHS purity or contents. Exact captured post-value installation still calls captured_assignment_destination_remains_current, including selector survival and intermediate-reference stability across RHS writes. Default-domain direct proofs are a separate route: fixed declaration geometry, call/index effect invalidation and conservative wildcard tracking remain their basis; the captured-value guard is not asserted to cover every domain-discharge path.
semantic_assessment.preserved_restoration: The scalar-value/primitive-bit interpretation gate, actual post-store parent predicate checks, entry-field capture, changed-sibling invalidation and read-only/write-only boundaries are unchanged by this diff. Fresh positive and rejecting raw observations preserve the previously fixed outcomes.
